source: Cambridge Final Exam Timetable June 2027, administrative zone 3 (version 1, November 2026)
zoneNote: These are the zone 3 papers (variant 1: 9084/11, 21, 31 and 41), sat in the afternoon. Schools in other administrative zones may sit a different variant in a different session: check your own zone's timetable or ask your exams officer.
asNote: Papers 1 and 2 are the AS Level. A Level students sit all four papers, in one series or with the AS in an earlier series.
